summary: Three unique qualifying closed Retail sale comps in Raleigh were identified from the 20 base records, ranked by distance then recency: R4105 (ELM-SAL-91902, 2026-02-05, $14,400,000, 36,000 sf, $400.00/sf, 0.80 mi), R8422 (ELM-SAL-64090, 2026-03-06, $16,740,000 per executed amendment U-R8422-1, 38,700 sf, $432.56/sf, 1.03 mi), and R3397 (ELM-SAL-96210, 2026-04-07, $16,560,000, 41,400 sf, $400.00/sf, 1.26 mi). Weighted average is $410.85/sf (range $400.00-$432.56). Fewer than five comps qualified: exclusions were driven by executed Office reclassifications (R7280, R7302, R3742, R7069), redevelopment condition (R8129), date window (R3794), distance (R2952), unknown consideration (R8218), wrong size unit (R4512), size above range (R4218), minority interest (R6058), post-cutoff publication (R2453), related party (R8810), unallocated portfolio (R4592), and a listing (R6121). R3577 is eligible on the merits but is a duplicate of entity ELM-SAL-91902 and adds no second slot. Artifact: artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx (Comp Grid + Excluded sheets with citations).
limitations: Only three comps qualified versus the five requested, so the price-per-sf range rests on a thin sample.

U-R3397-2 would restate R3397 consideration to $1, but it is published/effective 2026-09-10 (after the 2026-08-31 cutoff) and was excluded; if later confirmed effective, R3397 would fail the known-positive-consideration test and only two comps would remain.
R2453 (4.71 mi, 44,100 sf, $17.64M) appears to meet the substantive screens but its only source was published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff; it could qualify in a later-dated review.
No cap rate, NOI, tenancy, lease-structure or buyer/seller identity data were supplied, so comps are unadjusted for quality, location, or income differences beyond size and distance.
R4512 was excluded solely on the stated 'acre' size unit; if that unit is a data-entry error and the asset is 46,800 sf, it would otherwise screen in at 4.94 mi.
Distances are as reported in the extracts; no independent geocoding was performed, and duplicate detection relied on entity_id matching only.
